description: Solidon-Projekthinweise, Prüfungen und Schutz vor verwerfenden Git-Befehlen.

hooks.commandWindows: for /f "delims=" %R in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do @"%R\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -S -X utf8 "%R\.claude\hooks\solidon3d_hooks.py" sitzungsstart --codex

py -3 -S -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy,sys; p=Path.cwd(); r=next((r for r in (p,*p.parents) if (r/'.claude/hooks/solidon3d_hooks.py').is_file()),None); sys.argv=['solidon3d_hooks.py',*sys.argv[1:]]; r is not None and runpy.run_path(str(r/'.claude/hooks/solidon3d_hooks.py'),run_name='__main__')" sitzungsende --codex
for /f "delims=" %R in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do @"%R\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -S -X utf8 "%R\.claude\hooks\solidon3d_hooks.py" vor-bash --codex
for /f "delims=" %R in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do @"%R\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -S -X utf8 "%R\.claude\hooks\solidon3d_hooks.py" nach-aenderung --codex
for /f "delims=" %R in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do @"%R\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -S -X utf8 "%R\.claude\hooks\solidon3d_hooks.py" testlauf --codex
for /f "delims=" %R in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do @"%R\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -S -X utf8 "%R\.claude\hooks\solidon3d_hooks.py" abschluss --codex
